seoTitle: How to Cancel or Retract an Offer on eBay
metaDescription: Learn how to cancel a Best Offer or retract a bid on eBay, including eligibility rules and the official bid retraction form.
intro: Accidental bids and offers happen, and eBay does have a process for canceling them, though the rules differ depending on whether you're dealing with a Best Offer or an auction bid. This guide explains the difference between the two, how to use the official bid retraction form, and the eligibility rules that apply.

steps.heading: Identify whether it's a Best Offer or an auction bid
steps.body: Determine which type of offer you need to cancel, since eBay treats Best Offer retraction and auction bid retraction differently.

steps.heading: Locate the cancellation option
steps.body: On the website or mobile app, find the option to cancel or retract your offer from the relevant listing or offer history.

steps.heading: Use the official bid retraction form if needed
steps.body: For auction bids specifically, eBay provides an official retraction form that follows its eligibility rules.

steps.heading: Confirm the cancellation
steps.body: Submit the retraction and check that the offer or bid no longer shows as active on the listing.

faq.question: Can I cancel any offer or bid on eBay?
faq.answer: No, eBay sets specific eligibility rules for canceling offers, so not every situation qualifies for retraction.

faq.question: What's the difference between retracting a Best Offer and an auction bid?
faq.answer: Best Offer retraction applies to fixed offers made outside auctions, while auction bid retraction follows eBay's official bid retraction rules and form.

faq.question: Can sellers cancel an offer they received?
faq.answer: Yes, sellers who receive an unwanted offer can also go through a cancellation process, not just buyers.

faq.question: Why would I need to retract a bid?
faq.answer: Common reasons include accidental bids, pricing mistakes, or wanting to correct a last-minute checkout error.
